objects.focus_statement: At the Awareness level, the learner recognises and notices AI-related decisions in grounded understanding of AI systems and data behaviour and can demonstrate this in authentic tasks.
observable_behaviours: Recognises when Understanding AI and Data matters in familiar tasks and can name basic issues or concepts.
Uses provided examples, prompts, or checklists to make an initial decision in understanding ai and data.
Can give a simple explanation of choices in understanding ai and data, but usually needs support to go beyond the obvious case.

common_misconceptions.statement: assuming more data always means better performance
confusing generated text with factual understanding
Overstates competence because the task felt familiar.

role.how_it_changes_observation: Understanding AI and Data shows up differently across roles, so evidence should be taken from authentic decisions and artefacts rather than generic self-description.
role.calibration_rule: Use role-relevant examples but do not lower the core standard.

prior_ai_experience.calibration_rule: Look for decision quality and transfer, not just fluency or enthusiasm.
